body:
MDMA has seemed to lose some of its magic which isn't uncommon but I've noticed that recently different tested (with xtreme test kit) types of MDMA will just be speedy not loved up at all. but other types I still get empathy and all that good stuff.
I took the same amount of two diffrent types of molly.
1) 100mg moon rock no empathy just speedy and kinda nice.
2) 100mg of micro crystal MDMA I felt loved up and nice like I remember.
I wonder if it has to do with manufacturing  or purity but both seemed to test similarly in all respects with my kit. They were equally stimulating as well, one just did the loved up trick. I found this to be strange. I'm thinking one was made with better technique than the other or different synthesis. Very odd.
